en.title: SchedU
en.description: SchedU is a multi-unit clinic management platform built for healthcare operations. As Senior Front-End Engineer at HSys Group, I led a squad of 3 engineers, defined the front-end architecture and delivered scalable interfaces focused on usability, maintainability and performance. The product supports complex clinic workflows across multiple units, with reusable components, code review standards and CI/CD practices ensuring software reliability.

en.title: COR AI
en.description: COR AI is an AI generation platform for marketing agencies, enabling teams to create press releases, blog articles and social posts at scale. I led the technical architecture and development of complex user interfaces using React and TypeScript, building reusable and scalable UI patterns for AI-driven content workflows with a focus on high performance, accessibility and clean code.

en.title: Pickup Buddy
en.description: Pickup Buddy is a mobile app for student pickup and dismissal management, focused on optimizing and ensuring safety in student dismissal at the end of the school day. I led end-to-end feature development across the mobile app, REST API and product workflows — from discovery sessions with parents and school administrators to prototyping user flows, implementing the React Native front-end with Expo and building the Ruby on Rails API with unit testing.

en.title: Rexona
en.description: High-performance marketing web experience for Rexona, built as part of global campaign initiatives at The Brooklyn Brothers. Developed and maintained with React, TypeScript, Gatsby and Sanity, delivering optimized campaign pages aligned with international marketing strategies. Contributed to redesigning core project pages, improving Lighthouse performance score from 75 to 92.

en.title: Recepedia
en.description: Interactive marketing platform for Recepedia, developed at The Brooklyn Brothers using React, TypeScript, Gatsby, GraphQL and Sanity. Built and optimized campaign experiences for a global audience, collaborating in an Agile environment with designers and marketing strategists to deliver engaging, high-performance web applications.
